jury.why: Three model families rather than one, nothing clustered at the maximum, no median moved more than 1.5 from round 3, and peer review worked in the right direction — the 93 revised five criteria down and added a red flag it had missed; every surviving score names a file, line, hex, pixel or screen, and the chair re-verified all four load-bearing claims in source and render, voiding the three scores that rested only on the gate or on a refuted claim.

summary: Round 4 passes all five machine gates on merit and has found a real voice, but the two surfaces carrying the product's promise still fail: the keepsake reflection repeats a closing across two cards on one screen and mis-tags a cheered-on day as Mixed, and five unlayered helper classes in globals.css silently zero the intended page padding on nine screens — plus one 20×20px control in a state the gate structurally cannot render.
